title: The red-run check reads past the first word of a line
why: A misspelt or quoted mutant line passes the red-run check today, so a test commit can carry no real red run.
note: After #1691 lands. Three limits from #1691's round 3 reviewer (sonnet): (1) lint/check_red_run.py lines 107-125 read only the first word, so `(mutant A) ...`, `"mutant A" ...` and `mutnat A (x) python3 ...` pass. (2) `mutate=x` and `mutan=x` pass under the NAME=value exemption. (3) docs/decisions/red-run-trailer-on-test-commits.md line 25 (Known limits) leaves out that a real command starting mutat or mutan, such as `mutatest run`, is refused (use `./` or `env`).
